svg.aria-label: Serverless photo sharing. Customers: Mobile app, Web app; Edge: CloudFront, AWS WAF; Identity: Amazon Cognito; API: API Gateway; Request functions: Upload, Feed; Storage: Photo bucket, Photo metadata; Async processing: Photo events, Thumbnailer, Photo ready, Push; g8: CloudWatch, Secrets Manager. Connections: Mobile app to CloudFront (HTTPS); Web app to CloudFront (HTTPS); Mobile app to Amazon Cognito (sign in); Web app to Amazon Cognito (sign in); CloudFront to AWS WAF; CloudFront to API Gateway (API); API Gateway to Upload (upload request); API Gateway to Feed (feed request); Upload to Photo bucket (photo); Upload to Photo metadata (metadata); Feed to Photo metadata (query); Photo bucket sends events to Photo events (photo lands); Photo events sends events to Thumbnailer (reads); Thumbnailer to Photo bucket (thumbnails); Thumbnailer sends events to Photo ready (photo ready); Photo ready sends events to Push (notify)

g.text: AWS, eu-west-1: request path, async processing, shared services
